Frequently asked questions
What counts as unlimited day-to-day transactions?
Transactions include cheques drawn on the account, Coast Capital® and THE EXCHANGE® Network ATM withdrawals, Interac Direct Payment, pre-authorized payments, bill payments, transfers (between Coast Capital accounts), and withdrawals (in-branch/self serve). Deposits and electronic transfers (between Coast Capital accounts) performed via Coast Capital® ATM, Coast-by-Phone®, and Coast Capital digital banking are free & unlimited.
Do Seniors receive free personalized cheque orders?
Seniors(59+ years of age) receive free personalized cheque orders and free cheque images (returned with statements). Canadian office cheques and bank drafts are also free for Seniors.
